title: POST /api/payment — Ground-Truth Protocol Specification
description: Authoritative runtime contract derived from forensic analysis of PaymentService.js and PaymentController.js. This specification OVERRIDES legacy-api.md, which has not been updated since the 2022 multi-currency patch and incorrectly documents 'currency' as optional.

accountId.description: ID of the account to debit. Must resolve to a known entry in db.accounts or the service throws 'Account not found' → 400.

amount.description: Transaction amount, expressed in the resolved transaction currency. Deducted from account.balance on success.

currency.x-optionality-rule: REQUIRED when the target account's native currency is not 'USD'. OPTIONAL (defaults to account.currency) when the account is a USD account.

x-legacy-doc-override.legacyDocClaim: Optional — defaults to USD if omitted
x-legacy-doc-override.override: INCORRECT since the 2022 multi-currency patch. The runtime guard at PaymentService.js:36-38 makes this field strictly mandatory for any non-USD account. The legacy documentation was never updated to reflect this change.

x-runtime-guard.guardCode: if (!currency && account.currency !== 'USD') { throw new Error('Currency is required for international transactions'); }

onViolation.throws: Error('Currency is required for international transactions')

responseBody.error: Currency is required for international transactions

200.description: Payment accepted and committed. Transaction row inserted into db.transactions; account.balance decremented.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of transaction creation.

400.description: Validation or business-rule failure. Covers all thrown errors caught by PaymentController's catch block.

triggerConditions.guardCode: if (!account) throw new Error(`Account ${accountId} not found`)
if (!currency && account.currency !== 'USD') throw new Error('Currency is required for international transactions')
triggerConditions.note: This is the primary documented divergence from legacy-api.md. Confirmed by ERROR entries in transaction.log dated 2023-02-20 and 2023-03-10.

error.description: Runtime error message passed verbatim from the thrown Error object.
examples: Currency is required for international transactions

documentationDiscrepancy.summary: The legacy-api.md documentation has been SUPERSEDED for the 'currency' field and must not be trusted by integrators.

table.legacyApiMd: Optional — defaults to USD if omitted
table.runtimePaymentServiceJs: MANDATORY for non-USD accounts — throws if absent
Error('Currency is required for international transactions')
transactions.currency VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL — enforced at the database layer
